subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.

It is quite comprehensible that now young people's minds are constantly being reshaped by the media's constant meddling of certain __unfathomable__ ideas and moral standards.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2' **i.e. **'Comprehensible'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Comprehensible:** Something that can be understood or comprehended.(समझने योग्य)
 
• **Unfathomable: **Impossible to understand or comprehend (अथाह)
